license_required.quote: Persons entitled to practice optometry in Kansas shall be those persons licensed in accordance with the provisions of the optometry law.

interval_years.quote: Any license to practice optometry issued by the board shall expire on May 31 of the year specified by the board for the expiration of the license and shall be renewed on a biennial basis

renewal_fee_usd.quote: The biennial renewal fee shall not exceed $800.

required.quote: each licensee applying for license renewal shall furnish to the secretary of the board satisfactory evidence of successfully completing a minimum of 24 hours of continuing education annually

hours_per_period.quote: a minimum of 24 hours of continuing education annually

period_years.quote: a minimum of 24 hours of continuing education annually

value: ocular pharmacology, therapeutics or related topics (5 hours)
topical_requirements.quote: five hours of which shall relate to ocular pharmacology, therapeutics or related topics of study, approved by the board

available.quote: Any applicant for reciprocal licensure may in the board's discretion be licensed and issued a license without examination if the applicant has been in the active practice of optometry in another state for at least the three-year period immediately preceding the application for reciprocal licensure

requirements.value: Applicant must have been in active practice in another state for at least 3 years; present a certified copy of license from a state with equivalent requirements that accords like privilege to KS license holders; submit sworn statement that license was never limited/suspended/revoked; pass Kansas law examination and any required clinical practice examination; pay reciprocal license fee (not to exceed $450).
requirements.quote: Any applicant for reciprocal licensure may in the board's discretion be licensed and issued a license without examination if the applicant has been in the active practice of optometry in another state for at least the three-year period immediately preceding the application for reciprocal licensure

credential_type.quote: "License" means a license to practice optometry granted under the optometry law.

is_mandatory.quote: Persons entitled to practice optometry in Kansas shall be those persons licensed in accordance with the provisions of the optometry law.

title_protection.quote: a person shall be deemed to be practicing optometry within the meaning of the optometry law if such person in any manner: (1) Holds oneself out to the public as being engaged in or who maintains an office for the practice of optometry

scope_protection.quote: Any person who violates any of the provisions of this act shall be guilty of a class C misdemeanor for the first offense

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or securing an original or renewal license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has committed fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or securing an original or renewal license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of an act of unprofessional conduct or professional incompetence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has committed an act of unprofessional conduct or professional incompetence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony, whether or not related to the practice of optometry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has been convicted of a felony, whether or not related to the practice of optometry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of fraudulent or false advertisements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has used fraudulent or false advertisements.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or repeated violation of the optometry law, pharmacy act, or controlled substances act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has willfully or repeatedly violated the optometry law, the pharmacy act of the state of Kansas or the uniform controlled substances act, or any rules and regulations adopted pursuant thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of an order of the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has violated an order of the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to pay renewal fees specified in the act.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to pay renewal fees specified in this act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with annual continuing education requirements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to comply with the annual continuing education requirements as required by this act and the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing optometry under a false or assumed name or impersonating another practitioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has engaged in the practice of optometry under a false or assumed name, or the impersonation of another practitioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to perform optometry practice acts with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, alcoholism, drug use, or mental/physical condition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has the inability to perform optometry practice acts with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness, alcoholism, excessive use of drugs, controlled substances, chemical or any other type of material or as a result of any mental or physical condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: License revoked, suspended, limited, or disciplined by another jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has had a license to practice optometry revoked, suspended or limited, has been censured or has had other disciplinary action taken, or an application for a license denied, by the proper licensing authority of another state, territory, District of Columbia, or other country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any lawful rules and regulations or orders of the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has violated any lawful rules and regulations promulgated by the board or violated any lawful order or directive of the board previously entered by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cheating on or attempting to subvert the validity of the licensing examination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has cheated on or attempted to subvert the validity of the examination for a license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found to be mentally ill, disabled, not guilty by reason of insanity, or incompetent to stand trial by a court.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has been found to be mentally ill, disabled, not guilty by reason of insanity, not guilty because the licensee suffers from a mental disease or defect or incompetent to stand trial by a court of competent jurisdiction.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a federal law or regulation relating to controlled substances.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has violated a federal law or regulation relating to controlled substances.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to furnish legally requested information to the board or its investigators.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to furnish the board, or its investigators or representatives, any information legally requested by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sanctions or disciplinary actions by a peer review committee, health care facility, or professional association for conduct that would be grounds for discipline.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Sanctions or disciplinary actions have been taken against the licensee by a peer review committee, health care facility or a professional association or society for acts or conduct similar to acts or conduct which would constitute grounds for disciplinary action under this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report adverse actions taken against the licensee by another state, peer review body, health care facility, etc.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to report to the board any adverse action taken against the licensee by another state or licensing jurisdiction, a peer review body, a health care facility, a professional association or society, a governmental agency, by a law enforcement agency or a court

disciplinary_grounds.description: Surrendered a license or professional membership in another jurisdiction while under investigation for conduct that would be grounds for discipline.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has surrendered a license or authorization to practice optometry in another state or jurisdiction or has surrendered the licensee's membership on any professional staff or in any professional association or society while under investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report to the board the surrender of a license or professional membership in another jurisdiction while under investigation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to report to the board surrender of the licensee's license or authorization to practice optometry in another state or jurisdiction or surrender of the licensee's membership on any professional staff or in any professional association or society while under investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adverse judgment, award, or settlement resulting from a medical liability claim related to conduct that would be grounds for discipline.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has an adverse judgment, award or settlement against the licensee resulting from a medical liability claim related to acts or conduct similar to acts or conduct which would constitute grounds for disciplinary action under this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report an adverse malpractice judgment or settlement to the board.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to report to the board any adverse judgment, settlement or award against the licensee resulting from a malpractice liability claim

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain required professional liability insurance or pay annual premium.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to maintain a policy of professional liability insurance as required by K.S.A. 40-3402 or 40-3403a, and amendments thereto, or pay the annual premium as required by K.S.A. 40-3404

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly submitting misleading, deceptive, false, or fraudulent representations on a claim form, bill, or statement.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has knowingly submitted any misleading, deceptive, false or fraudulent representation on a claim form bill or statement.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide the patient with their written prescription for eyeglass lenses following the examination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has failed to provide to a patient the patient's written prescription for lenses for eyeglasses subsequent to the completion of the eye examination in accordance with applicable state or federal law.

insurance_required.quote: All applicants for licensure, in addition to successfully completing all other requirements for licensure, shall submit evidence satisfactory to the board of professional liability insurance in an amount acceptable to the board.

definition_quote.value: The practice of optometry means: (1) The examination of the human eye and its adnexae and the employment of objective or subjective means or methods (including the administering, prescribing or dispensing, of topical pharmaceutical drugs) for the purpose of diagnosing the refractive, muscular, or pathological condition thereof; (2) the prescribing, dispensing or adapting of lenses (including any ophthalmic lenses which are classified as drugs by any law of the United States or of this state), prisms, low vision rehabilitation services, orthoptic exercises and visual training therapy for the relief of any insufficiencies or abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexae; and (3) the prescribing, administering or dispensing of topical pharmaceutical drugs and oral drugs for the examination, diagnosis and treatment of ocular conditions and any insufficiencies or abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexae including adult open-angle glaucoma.
definition_quote.quote: The practice of optometry means: (1) The examination of the human eye and its adnexae and the employment of objective or subjective means or methods (including the administering, prescribing or dispensing, of topical pharmaceutical drugs) for the purpose of diagnosing the refractive, muscular, or pathological condition thereof

surgery_prohibited.quote: The practice of optometry shall not include: ... (2) the performance of surgery, including the use of lasers for surgical purposes, except that licensees may remove non-perforating foreign bodies from the cornea, conjunctiva or eyelids; remove eyelashes; scrape the cornea for diagnostic tests, smears or cultures; dilate, probe, irrigate or close by punctal plug the tear drainage structures of the eye; express conjunctival follicles or cysts; debridement of the corneal epithelium and co-management of post-operative care

surgery_definition.value: Surgery, including the use of lasers for surgical purposes, is excluded from optometric practice, with enumerated exceptions for minor procedures.

maximum_number_of_offices.quote: A licensee shall not be limited in the number of locations from which the licensee may engage in the practice of optometry
